#                                                                                                                                                                                                      
[media]
# **The Legend Begins...**
A ruthless master rises. Vengeful emperors scheme. Peasants sharpen their blades. They all have something to prove—and only one path forward: **Kung Fu.**

[media]
# **Step Into Your Own Kung Fu Movie**
You’re not watching a Kung Fu movie, you’re in it. Dragon Fist delivers fast-paced melee combat powered by physics and real martial arts.

[media]
# **Hone in Your Skills**
Practice strikes, blocks, dodges, and combos. There is an endless amount of combat to explore.

[media]
# **Play Your Way**
- Campaign
- Multiplayer (up to 8)
- Co-op Campaign
- Training
- and More...

[media]
# **Japanese Garden Is Out Now!**
A garden once known for tranquility has lost its peace as 3 new fighters enter the combat along with a new map, and 14 new additions to the fighter forge.

**Fighters**
- Fudou No Taki
- Ayuna Fujiwara
- Travis Decker

**Map**
- Japanese Garden

**Fighter Forge Additions**
- 3 New Special Moves
- 1 New Perk
- 11 New Clothing Options
